proposed.text: What are the four scope areas of the Construction Supervision Group under SPP 204-A?

options.text: Design Review, Cost Estimation, Scheduling, Safety, ensuring all aspects of the project are aligned with the initial design intent and budget constraints
Quality Control, Evaluation, Daily Reports, Filing/Documentation
Site Preparation, Material Testing, Labor Management, Handover, focusing on the readiness of the site and the quality of materials used
Procurement, Logistics, Quality Assurance, Closeout, which includes the final inspection and approval of all project components

rationale.a: Design review and cost estimation are not CSG scope areas. These fall under Design Development and Construction Management.
rationale.b: Correct. The four CSG scope areas are: (1) Quality Control of construction work, (2) Evaluation of progress and performance, (3) Daily Reports on construction activities, and (4) Filing/Documentation of all records.
rationale.c: Site preparation and labor management are contractor responsibilities, not CSG scope areas.
rationale.d: Procurement and logistics are construction management functions under SPP 204-B, not CSG scope areas.
rationale.correct: The CSG's four scope areas under SPP 204-A are: Quality Control (ensuring construction matches specifications), Evaluation (assessing progress and contractor performance), Daily Reports (documenting daily activities and issues), and Filing/Documentation (maintaining organized construction records).
rationale.takeaway: CSG scope: Quality Control, Evaluation, Daily Reports, Filing.
